decision.observation: 9 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The car is back on the gravel slightly right of centre, but its nose points up-right toward the white fence. The road runs straight up-frame to a junction lined with hay bales, Petrol banners and a left-hand crossroad.
decision.hypothesis: The nose is angled right, so a short W+A beat at low speed should straighten the car along the road without a large speed loss.
decision.memory: Approaching the junction from the south on the fence straight. Petrol arches at the top and the bales line the left crossroad.
